files.heard: what is the return window for a fashion item delivered on fifth october twenty twenty six
files.reply: I'm ZentroMart's AI assistant. Fashion items have 15 calendar days from delivery. Orders placed in the 1-15 October festive sale get 30 days instead.

files.heard: how long does a upi refund take
files.reply: I'm ZentroMart's AI assistant. Refunds to UPI take 1 to 3 business days after the refund is initiated.

files.heard: my order is already on its way can i cancel it now
files.reply: I'm ZentroMart's AI assistant. A shipped order can't be cancelled. You can refuse the parcel at the door, or accept it and return it within its return window. For a prepaid order, the refund follows once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.
